name: Data Protection Board of India (DPBI)
mandate: Adjudicating non-compliance, hearing grievances after company failure to resolve within 30 days, and levying penalties up to ₹250 Crore.
escalation_conditions: Company fails to respond within 30 days or rejects erasure without statutory justification.
penalty_scope: Up to ₹250 Cr for failure to take reasonable security safeguards; ₹200 Cr for failure to notify breach.
appeal_timeline: File within 90 days of company default or grievance officer response.

name: CNIL (France)
mandate: Supervising data processing, enforcing cookie consent regulations, issuing Art. 83 administrative fines.
escalation_conditions: Data controller fails to respond to Article 17 erasure request within 1 month.
penalty_scope: Up to €20M or 4% of total worldwide annual turnover.

name: Information Commissioner's Office (ICO)
mandate: Investigating complaints, enforcing privacy and electronic communications regulations.
escalation_conditions: Organization refuses right to access/erasure without valid lawful exemption.
penalty_scope: Up to £17.5M or 4% of global turnover.
appeal_timeline: Within 3 months of last contact with organization.

name: California Privacy Protection Agency (CPPA)
mandate: Enforcing consumer rights to know, delete, correct, and opt-out of the sale/sharing of personal information.
escalation_conditions: Business fails to process CCPA Do-Not-Sell or Deletion request within 45 days.
